summary: Interactive Brokers Group filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an offering of 2,499,567 shares of Class A common stock, issued to IBG Holdings LLC in exchange for membership interests in IBG LLC. No cash proceeds are received and no material dilution is expected. The last reported sale price was $86.26 on July 29, 2026. This is a routine exchange transaction under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. No premium, advisor, or strategic event is involved; it is a standard capital structure maintenance. Watch for any subsequent unusual activity, but this filing is ordinary in nature.
